column3: Finding the incident planted in the CSE dataset was table stakes, so we decided the real project was proving our detector would catch the next one, the one nobody described to us.
It uncovered a hidden 22-event, multi-stage attack across 180,800 unlabeled Apache log entries, achieving **0.918 PR-AUC** and reducing false positives to **zero** with detector-guided LLM triage.
Processed the full 180,800-line CSE dataset with zero rejected records and surfaced the key suspicious sequences.
Our project is made to help analyze threats and anomalies within network traffic. We used the legacy MACCDC dataset as the premise to build our tools from.
Pew Pew is a FastAPI analyzer that turns the legacy CCDC intrusion dataset into a forensic-ready narrative by auto-mapping hosts, aggressive attackers, targeted victims, and an attack timeline.
End‑to‑end pipeline from PCAP ingestion to evidence‑backed AI narratives, running reliably on real data (MACCDC 2012).
A Vite + React + TypeScript app. Detection and planning run entirely in the browser on network.json, ops.json, and telemetry.csv, with no answer keys.
Counts down to shutdown: for every failed pump, it projects when the tank will reach its limit, with a confidence range.
To ensure potion accountability, we implement discrepancy detection that compares Potion Transport Tickets (which record witch collections) with the actual drained volumes.
PoyoLabs is a gamified dashboard that allows users to track and monitor multiple cauldrons (data points) from one hand-designed interface.

Our project, PipeBrains, was trained using a machine learning algorithm from Scikit on the given datasets by EOG. It produced promising results, with an R^2 of around 94% and lesser mean error. With this, our trained model was able to predict possible hydrates in the pipes
Additionally, we integrated the LumaLabs AI API to generate realistic videos, which both open and close our game with an immersive storyline and stunning visuals
What you hear: Our NSA HEARSAY challenge model scores every 4 s of the caller's voice real-vs-synthetic: two fine-tuned XLS-R models plus a gradient-boosted model on classic spectral features, fused.
Our submitted detector received a **0.0248 minDCF** on the organizer’s evaluator, the second-lowest raw score on the competition leaderboard.
The harness ingests financial research from MCP data source, structures the corpus into searchable evidence, and answers research questions with verified citations.
Answers questions over large financial research corpora with [n] citations that open the exact source lines.
Grok searches X for other fans' videos of the same moment and compares the stage, lighting and crowd in our frames against what people posted.
We used Grok to create an auto merge GitHub agent. Ran 3 Cursor swarms to build UI, test, and integrate AI features into our website.
FUELICIENT gives a clean UI for Toyota fuel-efficiency data exploration, coupled with a system for retaining previous analyses on a per-account basis.
